functions.name: ASK
functions.description: Ask Sheetdot AI a question about an Excel cell or range using cached responses.

parameters.name: question
parameters.description: Prompt or question to evaluate against the range

parameters.name: contextRange
parameters.description: Cell or range providing row/table context

functions.name: WATCH
functions.description: Register a recurring Sheetdot watch for a cell/range and return the latest cached answer.

parameters.name: question
parameters.description: Recurring check or question to evaluate on schedule

parameters.name: contextRange
parameters.description: Cell or range monitored by this watch
